residual_sampling.probability: 0.9 * detail_l2 / sum_detail_l2 + 0.1 / pairs; uniform if all zero

prac.principal: one randomized subspace iteration, no SVD
prac.tail: independent Gaussian QR in principal orthogonal complement
prac.rebuild: every forward; no uncounted persistent basis
prac.scope: PRAC-style primitive, not official reproduction or byte-matched claim

gate_for_learning.required: both datasets at4096; forward exact; B and input gradient relative L2 <=1e-5; all-details A relative L2 <=1e-5; finite all draws
gate_for_learning.practical_control_requirement: must not be dominated in peak and time by exact checkpoint or AMP checkpoint; gradient accuracy condition is a conservative screening proxy, not a publication or forecasting-success criterion

pilot_if_gate_passes.initialization: same pinned base and fresh seed-matched rank8 LoRA per arm; no reuse of diagnostic warmed optimization state
pilot_if_gate_passes.train_origins: 4096..5900 inclusive step64, sampled identically per seed across arms
pilot_if_gate_passes.selection: lowest mean native validation loss, earliest step tie; seal all arms before development E
pilot_if_gate_passes.success: both datasets, seed-mean development loss degradation <=0.5% versus strongest selected control and peak >=5% lower with step time <=1.15x; report each seed and fixed-update/fixed-wall-clock curves; reused development E is not independent holdout evidence
